arxiv-2102-07067.title: Fast Monocular Hand Pose Estimation on Embedded Systems Journal: Journal of Systems Architecture
arxiv-2102-07067.creator: Shan An, Xiajie Zhang, Dong Wei, Haogang Zhu, Jianyu Yang, Konstantinos A. Tsintotas
arxiv-2102-07067.description: Abstract Hand pose estimation is a fundamental task in many human-robot interaction-related applications. However, previous approaches suffer from unsatisfying hand landmark predictions in real-world scenes and high computation burden. This paper proposes a fast and accurate framework for hand pose estimation, dubbed as “FastHand".

arxiv-2111-09432.title: Electron Losses in Hypersonic Flows This article will appear soon in Physics of Fluids. Copyright 2021 Bernard Parent, Prasanna Thoguluva Rajendran, Ajjay Omprakas. This article is distributed under a Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) License.
arxiv-2111-09432.creator: B. Parent, P. Thoguluva Rajendran, and A. Omprakas University of Arizona, Tucson, AZ 85721
arxiv-2111-09432.description: Abstract The first comprehensive study of electron gains and losses in hypersonic air flows including the full coupling between the non-neutral plasma sheaths and the quasi-neutral plasma flow is here presented. Such is made possible by the use of advanced numerical methods that overcome the stiffness associated with the plasma sheaths.

arxiv-2201-07311.title: Datasheet for the Pile
arxiv-2201-07311.creator: Stella Biderman, Kieran Bicheno, Leo Gao
arxiv-2201-07311.description: Abstract This datasheet describes the Pile, a 825 825 GiB dataset of human-authored text compiled by EleutherAI for use in large-scale language modeling. The Pile is comprised of 22 different text sources, ranging from original scrapes done for this project, to text data made available by the data owners, to third-party scrapes available online.

arxiv-2202-04797.title: Local breaking of the spin degeneracy in the vortex states of Ising superconductors: Induced antiphase ferromagnetic order
arxiv-2202-04797.creator: Hong-Min Jiang, Xiao-Yin Pan
arxiv-2202-04797.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hong-Min Jiang, Xiao-Yin Pan. Ising spin-orbital coupling is usually easy to identify in the Ising superconductors via an in-plane critical field enhancement, but we show that the Ising spin-orbital coupling also manifests in the vortex physics for perpendicular magnetic fields.

arxiv-2406-14268.title: A hierarchical Bayesian approach to point source analysis in high-energy neutrino telescopes Journal: ApJ Facilities: Stan:2023pf 2013A&A...558A..33A ; 2018AJ....156..123A numpy Hunter:2007 2020SciPy-NMeth collette_python_hdf5_2014 ; h5py_7560547 Kumar_ArviZ_a_unified
arxiv-2406-14268.creator: Francesca Capel, Julian Kuhlmann, Christian Haack, Martin Ha Minh, Hans Niederhausen, Lisa Schumacher
arxiv-2406-14268.description: Abstract We propose a novel approach to the detection of point-like sources of high-energy neutrinos. Motivated by evidence for emerging sources in existing data, we focus on the characterisation and interpretation of these sources. The hierarchical Bayesian model is implemented in the Stan platform, enabling computation of the posterior distribution with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo.

arxiv-2406-17760.title: Dark photon pair production via off-shell dark Higgs at FASER
arxiv-2406-17760.creator: Takeshi Araki, Kento Asai, Yohei Nakashima, Takashi Shimomura
arxiv-2406-17760.description: Abstract We consider a dark photon model in which the dark U(1) gauge symmetry is spontaneously broken by a vacuum expectation value of a new scalar boson. We focus on the ForwArd Search ExpeRiment (FASER) and calculate its sensitivity to the dark photon produced from the off-shell decay of the new scalar boson.

arxiv-2412-02912.title: ShapeWords: Guiding Text-to-Image Synthesis with 3D Shape-Aware Prompts
arxiv-2412-02912.creator: Dmitry Petrov Pradyumn Goyal Divyansh Shivashok Yuanming Tao, Melinos Averkiou Evangelos Kalogerakis
arxiv-2412-02912.description: Abstract We introduce ShapeWords 1 1 1 Project page (with code): lodurality.github.io/shapewords , an approach for synthesizing images based on 3D shape guidance and text prompts. ShapeWords incorporates target 3D shape information within specialized tokens embedded together with the input text, effectively blending 3D shape awareness with textual context to guide the image synthesis process.

arxiv-2502-03485.title: Intrinsic Energy Resolution of Plastic Scintillator Tiles: Muon Beamtest Results
arxiv-2502-03485.creator: M. Joos
arxiv-2502-03485.description: Abstract This study explores the feasibility of using scintillation detectors for muon calorimetry through experiments conducted at CERN’s T10 beamline. Results from organic scintillators with varying thicknesses and readout methods, as well as a lead-glass calorimeter, showed minimal correlation between muon energy and the peak or spread of the detected signal amplitudes.

arxiv-2502-08831.title: Quantum communication over bandwidth-and-time-limited channels
arxiv-2502-08831.creator: Aditya Gandotra, Zhaoyou Wang, Aashish A. Clerk, Liang Jiang
arxiv-2502-08831.description: Abstract Standard communication systems have transmission spectra that characterize their ability to perform frequency multiplexing over a finite bandwidth. Realistic quantum signals in quantum communication systems like transducers are inherently limited in time due to intrinsic decoherence and finite latency, which hinders the direct implementation of frequency-multiplexed encoding.

arxiv-2601-23241.title: When low-loss paths make a binary neuron trainable: detecting algorithmic transitions with the connected ensemble
arxiv-2601-23241.creator: Damien Barbier
arxiv-2601-23241.description: Abstract We study the connected ensemble, a statistical-mechanics framework that characterizes the formation of low-loss paths in rugged landscapes. First introduced in 12 , this ensemble allows one to identify when a network can be trained on a simple task and which minima should be targeted during training.

arxiv-2602-04371.title: Canonical differential equations beyond polylogs
arxiv-2602-04371.creator: Fabian J. Wagner
arxiv-2602-04371.description: Abstract Feynman integrals whose associated geometries extend beyond the Riemann sphere, such as elliptic curves and Calabi–Yau varieties, are increasingly relevant in modern precision calculations. They arise not only in collider cross-section calculations, but also in the post-Minkowskian expansion of gravitational-wave scattering.

pmc-12387997.title: Evaluating the Efficacy of a Novel Titanium Cage System in ALIF and LLIF: A Retrospective Clinical and Radiographic Analysis
pmc-12387997.creator: Ryan W Turlip, Mert Marcel Dagli, Richard J Chung, Daksh Chauhan, Richelle J Kim, Julia Kincaid, Hasan S Ahmad, Yohannes Ghenbot, Jang Won Yoon, Zach Pennington
pmc-12387997.description: Background/Objectives: The success of lumbar interbody fusion depends on the implant design and the surgical approach used. This study evaluated the clinical and radiographic outcomes of lateral lumbar interbody fusion (LLIF) and anterior lumbar interbody fusion (ALIF) using a 3D-printed porous titanium interbody cage system.

pmc-12445129.title: The Danger of Long‐Term Use of Rauwolfia vomitoria Afzel. (Apocynaceae) Aqueous Root Back Extract for Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
pmc-12445129.creator: Perpetua Dagadu, Samuel Adjei, George Awuku Asare, Kwasi Bugyei, Rodger Apandago Mahamadu, Ufuoma Ohwo, Habibur Rahman
pmc-12445129.description: Rauwolfia vomitoria has recently been reported as a promising phytomedicine for benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). It has a wide range of therapeutic advantages intermingled with diverse controversies of toxicities, necessitating the need to proceed on a long‐term investigation to determine the safety of R. vomitoria. The study is aimed at determining the subchronic toxicity of R. vomitoria.

pmc-13057181.title: Soil nitrous oxide and methane emissions in contrasting land use of the West African Sudanian savanna
pmc-13057181.creator: Francis E Oussou, Ralf Kiese, Souleymane Sy, Jan Bliefernicht, Ines Spangenberg, Samuel Guug, Anja Schäfler-Schmid, Rainer Steinbrecher, Frank Neidl, Michael Ayamba, Luitpold Hingerl, Emmanuel Quansah, Alex Frempong, Patrick Davies, Windmanagda Sawadogo, Christiana F Olusegun, Ricky M Mwanake, Nicai
pmc-13057181.description: Changes in land use and land management can have significant effects on the global emissions budget, influencing the climate through biogeochemical processes. However, their impacts on major soil greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in West Africa remain poorly documented and understood.

pmc-13374345.title: Health anxiety among medical and non-medical university students in Palestine: associations with intolerance of uncertainty, daily phone use, and field of study
pmc-13374345.creator: Ahmad Fasfoos, Muhammad Suliman Sunkrot, Islam Jadallah, Ahmad H. Id’eas, Mai Hoshieh, Tasneem Haytham, Saja Aljunaidi, Janaa Issa, Amro K. Al-Manasrah, Ahmad Ahmoud
pmc-13374345.description: BackgroundMedical student syndrome (MSS) is commonly used to describe illness-related anxiety in academic settings, particularly anxiety linked to exposure to disease-related information. However, it remains unclear whether elevated health anxiety is actually more common among medical students than among students in other fields.
